text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Time to start "The Great Plan for Windy-chan to Hijack the Academy"~!

What on earth is she talking about...?
For now, I listened closely to her story—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yesterday, there was a movie playing where bad guys hijacked a hotel and trapped all the guests!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone tries their hardest to solve the riddles
and escape, but nobody can get out at all—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, the bad guy was super awesome!
He was the baddest of the bad~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And so—... I'm not copying!
It's inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Struck by inspiration,
I've devised a grand plan to take over the academy!"

Thud! A proposal was placed down right before my eyes.
It was thick and filled with detailed plans.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Impressive, isn't it!
It is the culmination of my blood, sweat, and tears!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, take it!
You're an evil tactical mastermind, after all,
so I'll let you join my ranks!

...Regardless, nothing will start unless I look at the contents.
With that in mind, I decided to read a bit further into the proposal.

Pulling pranks all over the school, barricading hallways
with panels, and broadcasting a takeover to the whole student body.

Give them riddles to solve...
and once they finally catch Shinko Windy who's hiding,
the takeover is over!
In short, it's basically like a massive prank, riddle-solving, and hide-and-seek event all rolled into one.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hijack the whole academy!
And plunge everyone into the depths of pure terror, nanoda!!

Trying to do everything could negatively impact
her training. But at the same time,
I don't want her hard work to go to waste...
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all to make this a success!!
Let's hold off on this plan...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: O-Only... half!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, that's way too small!
We gotta hijack it in a much flashier way~~~!
choice_data_list: It's precisely because it's cramped that you can obsess over the details.

text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Academy grounds are quite vast.
Making the whole place feel scary would be a monumental task.
So, I told them that by cutting the targets in half, they could redirect that effort into stage direction and scare people to their hearts' content...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, I see.
Not a bad idea coming from you, nanoda.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the material costs will be cut in half,
which means I can buy that much more scary toys.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I can set up way more toy bugs
and jack-in-the-boxes now!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright! You're hired!
We're gonna hijack half the academy~!!

All in all, and so――
Shinko Windy's plan to take over the academy
quietly began.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes you Windy-chan's
Trainer! Nishishishi!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's begin the operation right away!
And the place she led me to was—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hijack the academy,
so don't you dare get in my way, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's best to crush your enemies before they can act!

“—That said,
would the student council even permit such a thing...?”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, very well.
I shall make a proposal to the Chairwoman."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "The student council was just brainstorming ideas for an event, you see. Academy life needs a little excitement, after all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This proposal is flawless, right down to the risk management. Impressive. Please, make it a grand success.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...! H-Hmph!
It's not like I'm doing this for your sake!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, okay...
I'll at least praise you for praising me!
...Hehe, ni-shi-shi-shi-shi!

In any case, and so—
Shinko Windy's plan to take over the Academy
had quietly begun.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heeeyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Dummy, dummy, dummy!
Why would you say something like that~?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Stupid Trainer! You're not even
my Trainer anymore, so there!

"...Anyway, I decided to first catch her, calm her down,
and try to persuade her a little more."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
An impact on training?
Hmph, as if that could ever happen!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan is amazing! Both my pranks and my racing are totally flawless!
choice_data_list: Still, what if it causes an issue?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh...!
Th-There's no way that could be true!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there's absolutely... no way...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! There's no way that's true!
There's no way, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna rewrite the proposal just a bit!
Well... I came up with a new idea!"

And so, using a toned-down proposal...
Shinko Windy's plan to take over the academy began.
